lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately vertical columns and horizontal rows on the lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a regular grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal edge to low-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct triangular notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
